content: Herot no Yesus bona Jon yaage bisemu nigigou fai iwai.
Saini waha langa gabman amugou Herot no dada Yesus onona waha nomo aasa isai,
onodu bona no nomo haruwe fai lenigai, “Fai behanga, no Jon yaage bisemu nigigou. No matmat langa ege jayai. Waha bona no dodokawou tafei nomo danga bagu.”
Amina Herot no Herodias tai, no Filip woya, Herot bemu. Ono wainga Jon no Herot benou letuwai, “ne aita tene wa, edo uwa.”
Ono wainga, Herot no Jon taidu sen langa dage tudu bona, dagou mata langa tafa tuwai.
Herot no Jon dukote wonga umei nomo onowai, onou wa, no fai-aita bagu umuge nigai, taate bona, nere ninanege benou isane, Jon no profet.

Fati ete langa nere fai ila maidu Herot ngate da nyane, anya bisi tuwai waha nomo fati ninau isei nomo bona. Ono ganenga saini waha langa Herodias mago no nere gamanege langa moone uyai. Ono wainga Herot no gaude tuwai.
Ono wainga Herot no beele baara tawai, “Ngalenga tigini ouwe la, ne taate dada bonahe isoki hiyahenga wonga, ji ne hinonboni.”
Ono wainga Herodias aita waha nomo anya, no ninau tuwainga letuwai, “Ne Jon yaage bisemu nigigou fai, nomo mora haaya ete langa tafadu bonahe, te tamaidu hiyau.”

King no beele waha isidu, huwanya ou tuwai. Ono wainga no beele danga bagu baara tawai waha bona ninau isidu, nere fai gaara yafadu da nyane waha agenege langa mayau tei nomo awai. Onodu bona no oota fai mago lewai onounga onowei nomo bona lenigai.
Onodu bona, no fai ete dagou mata langa goidu oota fai lenigonga Jon bou karuwei nomo bona huuru tuwai.
Onodu nere nomo mora haaya ete langa tafadu bode te tamaidu aita magana waha tuwane. Ono wanenga no tedu bona anya togoi fuwai.
Ono wanenga nere Jon nomo disaipel maidu bode Jon gogala tedu u-u kuru wane. Nere u-u kurudu bode, nere goidu Yesus letuwane.
Yesus no fai 5,000 da nigai.

Ono wanenga, Yesus no Jon dukote wane beele waha isidu bona, no matane waha awadu bona bot ete tedu, ha ulate fai uwau langa goyai. No nomo disaipel bagunga goyane. Ono wanenga nere fai-aita bagu baingaro isane, onodu bode nere taun awarudu bode, golodu no oojo tudu goyane.
Iinga Yesus no goi horiyedu bona nere fai-aita toomaro yafa ganenga nerigai. Onodu bona no nere bona aau warai, ono wainga no nere nebere taura fai taura jigemu nagai.
Ono wainga esuwa nomo disaipel maidu bode letuwane, “Ha beha fai uwau, saini amina usu waha. Onou waha bona ne fai-aita bagu huuru nigahenga goyode. Nere matane kejiwe langa goidu da ejiya wode.”
Ono wanenga Yesus no disaipel lenigai, “Nere taate bode goyode? Tere tage we nere da nigagu.”
Ono wainga nere letuwane, “Ere belanga da bainga uwa. Beret anyimu kouwou bagu, hoowe nga nononga wahanga inyide.”
Ono wanenga no lenigai, “Elegedu belanga tamai hayagu.”

Onodu bona no fai-aita bagu jiigu langa yafei nomo lenigai. Onodu bona no beret anyimu kouwou bagu, hoowe nga nononga waha bagu elegedu bona, ha laluwa feele bona, Itou hilobainga tuwai. Onodu bona no beret lalatidu bona nere disaipel nigai. Ono wainga nere fai-aita bagu nigane,
ono wanenga nere oruwa nyanenga ogonege digai. Onodu nere da matau-matau inyai waha elege komomudu bode kekele 12 jiriwane.
Nere fai 5,000 onou da nyane. Nere aita magana bagu lelege nigegu uwa.
Yesus no yaage katiwou ouwe langa golowai.
Ariya Yesus no nere disaipel bot digedu amugedu yaage katiwou, ulate langa goyei nomo bona lenigai. Onodu no nogo yafa bona fai-aita bagu amugedu huuru nigonga goyei nomo bona onowai.
No fai-aita bagu huuru nigainga goi hara ganenga, no nogonga hauyawei nomo bona muju digedu ouwe langa manai. Esuwa hoonga mini gainga, no nogonga muju langa yafai.
Ono gainga bot amina goi baae wainga, jagui bot mutu fuu tubona, hiiri bot fekula tuwai.
Hamba wona jugu gainga, Yesus no yaage katiwou ouwe langa golobona maidu nere disaipel bagu heigai.
Ono wainga nere no yaage kati wou ouwe langa golo wainga uredu bode, nere umuge bode garabai narigai. Nere lewane, “Be barau ete.” Onodu bode nere umugedu bode inyangaaro hiri wane.
Ono wanenga fasadu onou Yesus no nere lenigai, “Tere danga bagu yafagu. Be ji wenga. Tere adai umugagu.”
Ono wainga Pita no ege gidu benou letuwai, “Anyakaro, be ne wonga wa, ne ji lehiyahenga ji edo yaage ouwe langa golodu ne bagu goyoni.”
Ono wainga Yesus no letuwai, “Ne mayau.” Ono wainga Pita no bot awadu bona, yaage ouwe langa golodu Yesus bagu goyai.
Ono wai wa, no jagui danga bagu uredu bona no umugai, onodu bona no menanga onou yaage gamu minidu, benou yaurai, “Anyakaro, ne ji hoyo hiyau.”
Ono wainga fasadu onou Yesus no owo ayadu Pita yaasu tubona letuwai, “Ne huwanyate ngalengawou menakele mene. Ne taate boni ninate nga baguni?”
Onodu bodere nere bot langa digarenga jagui folowai.
Ono wainga nere fai bot langa yafane waha, nere no unyi isou bode, lewane “Ngalenga tigini ne Itou Nomo Idau.”
Yesus no Genesaret langa taura fai baingaro taura jigemu nigai.
Onodu bode nere yaage katiwou fadu bode goi Genesaret ulate langa horiyane.
Ono wanenga nere fai ulate waha-ha nere alai, wa Yesus. Onodu bode nere matane jugu-jugu oruwa langa beele huuru wane, ono wanenga nere taura fai oruwanga hanigedu no bagu mayane.
Onodu bode nere Yesus danga bagu isoki tuwane, no taura fai awa nigonga nere owonege ayadu nomo kolos mutu la yaasuwei nomo bode. Ono wanenga nere oruwa onou ono wane waha nere ege hilou heigane.
